title: 化学品储存原则与相容性
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/043_化学品储存原则与相容性.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/043_化学品储存原则与相容性/src.py

points.K1: 储存不当，就谈不上安全
points.K4: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室
points.K6: 固定位置，阴凉通风避光
points.K7: 台面和通风柜不是仓库
points.K8: 放低放稳，大瓶下层配托盘
points.K12: 过期变质试剂及时清理

shots.scene: 欣欣站在分区整齐的试剂柜前报题
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a neatly sectioned chemical storage cabinet and greets the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲化学品储存原则与相容性。
overlay: 化学品储存原则与相容性

shots.scene: 阿杰把新买的试剂按名字排进柜子，酸碱挨在一起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student lines up new reagent bottles in a cabinet in name order; an acid sits next to a base.
shots.narration: 阿杰按名字顺序，把试剂排进柜子。

shots.scene: 小研看到后皱眉，指着挨在一起的两瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student frowns and points at the two bottles side by side.
shots.narration: 小研：这样放，可能出大事。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰一起把瓶子取出，准备重新摆放
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student take bottles out to rearrange them.
shots.narration: 储存，也有一套规矩。

shots.section_title: 储存不当，就谈不上安全
shots.scene: 试剂瓶在柜子里，时钟转了很多圈
shots.prompt_en: Reagent bottles sit in a cabinet while a clock spins many times. No text.
shots.narration: 化学品大部分时间，都在柜子里。
overlay: 储存不当，就谈不上安全

shots.section_title: 储存不当，就谈不上安全
shots.scene: 柜子里一瓶倾倒，旁边警示
shots.prompt_en: One bottle tipped over inside a messy cabinet, a warning icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 储存没做好，操作也谈不上安全。

shots.scene: 柜子分成几个区：火焰、圆圈火焰、腐蚀、骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: A storage area divided into zones marked with icons: flame, flame over circle, corrosion, skull. No text.
shots.narration: 按主要危险性质，分类分区存放。

shots.scene: 【实拍】本校化学品储存区分类分区实景，易燃、腐蚀等专柜（遮挡品牌，不拍具体试剂名）
shots.prompt_en: A real chemical storage room with separate cabinets for flammables, corrosives and toxics. No readable text.
shots.narration: 易燃、腐蚀、毒害、气瓶，各用专柜。

shots.scene: 一本国家标准和实验室储存区并排
shots.prompt_en: A national standard booklet with a blank cover beside a lab storage area. No text.
shots.narration: 储存原则，参照危险化学品储存通则。

shots.scene: 储存场所：通风、防火、温湿度计、灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: A storage room with a vent, a fire extinguisher, a temperature and humidity gauge and a no-fire sign. No text.
shots.narration: 场所要通风防火，控制温度湿度。

shots.scene: 台账本和带锁的专柜
shots.prompt_en: An inventory ledger next to a locked dedicated cabinet. No readable text.
shots.narration: 建好台账，剧毒品专人专柜。

shots.scene: 酸瓶和碱瓶挨着，打叉，热浪图标
shots.prompt_en: An acid bottle next to a base bottle, crossed out, with a heat wave icon. No text.
shots.narration: 酸碱放一起，漏了会剧烈放热。

shots.scene: 含氰试剂和酸瓶之间画上隔板，毒气云打叉
shots.prompt_en: A divider separates a cyanide reagent bottle from an acid bottle; a toxic cloud icon is crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 含氰试剂碰到酸，会放出剧毒气体。

shots.scene: 氧化剂和易燃物分在两个柜子
shots.prompt_en: An oxidizer bottle and a flammable bottle placed in two separate cabinets. No text.
shots.narration: 氧化剂远离易燃物，绝不能同放。

shots.scene: 墙上贴着空白的相容性表格，格子红绿两色
shots.prompt_en: A blank compatibility chart on the wall with red and green squares. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室可张贴禁配表，随时对照。

shots.scene: 小研翻说明书第7、10部分
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks sections seven and ten of a data booklet.
shots.narration: 拿不准，查说明书的储存和反应性。

shots.section_title: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室
shots.scene: 遇水着火的瓶子和易燃液体在不同房间
shots.prompt_en: A water-reactive bottle in one room and flammable liquids in another room, a wall between them. No text.
shots.narration: 遇水着火的物质，不与易燃液体同室。
overlay: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室

shots.section_title: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室
shots.scene: 水管和喷淋头远离遇水危险品
shots.prompt_en: A water-reactive bottle in a dry sealed container away from pipes and sprinklers. No text.
shots.narration: 遇水危险品要干燥密封，远离水源。

shots.section_title: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室
shots.scene: 易燃液体柜旁边放着灭火器，水桶打叉
shots.prompt_en: A flammable cabinet room with the right extinguisher; a water bucket is crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 同室着火，用水灭火会更危险。

shots.scene: 按字母顺序排列的瓶子，相邻两瓶冒危险图标
shots.prompt_en: Bottles lined up in alphabetical order; two neighbors flash a danger icon. No text.
shots.narration: 按名字顺序排，危险品可能挨着。

shots.scene: 瓶子重新按类别归位，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The bottles move into category zones by hazard icon, with a check. No text.
shots.narration: 先分类别，类内再按名字排。

shots.scene: 柜门内侧贴着分区示意图
shots.prompt_en: A zone map icon taped inside a cabinet door, showing colored sections. No text.
shots.narration: 柜门贴分区图，放回不出错。

shots.scene: 合格的试剂瓶和破损瓶，破损的打叉
shots.prompt_en: A sound reagent bottle and a cracked bottle; the cracked one is crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 容器本身要合格，没有破损。

shots.scene: 腐蚀液装在耐腐蚀瓶里，金属罐打叉
shots.prompt_en: A corrosive liquid in a resistant bottle gets a check; the same in a metal can is crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 还要和物质匹配，耐腐蚀、能密封。

shots.scene: 饮料瓶装试剂打叉，敞口烧杯打叉
shots.prompt_en: A drink bottle filled with reagent and an open beaker, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不用饮料瓶装试剂，不敞口放。

shots.scene: 生物样品放进密封防漏盒
shots.prompt_en: Sample tubes go into a sealed leak-proof box. No text.
shots.narration: 生物样品，放进密封防漏的盒子。

shots.section_title: 固定位置，阴凉通风避光
shots.scene: 每个瓶子在柜格里有自己的位置，用完放回
shots.prompt_en: Each bottle has its own marked spot in the cabinet; a hand returns one to its place. No text.
shots.narration: 每种化学品有固定位置，用完放回。
overlay: 固定位置，阴凉通风避光

shots.section_title: 固定位置，阴凉通风避光
shots.scene: 阳光照射和暖气旁的瓶子打叉
shots.prompt_en: Bottles in direct sunlight and next to a radiator are crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 远离热源，避开阳光直射。

shots.section_title: 固定位置，阴凉通风避光
shots.scene: 阴凉通风的储存区，排风扇转动
shots.prompt_en: A cool, ventilated storage area with an exhaust fan turning. No text.
shots.narration: 储存处要通风、阴凉、避光。

shots.section_title: 固定位置，阴凉通风避光
shots.scene: 需冷藏的瓶子放进冰箱，冰箱上有防爆图标
shots.prompt_en: A bottle that needs cold storage goes into a refrigerator with an explosion-proof icon. No text.
shots.narration: 要冷藏的易燃试剂，用防爆冰箱。

shots.section_title: 台面和通风柜不是仓库
shots.scene: 实验台上堆满瓶子，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lab bench cluttered with many reagent bottles, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 台面不是化学品仓库。
overlay: 台面和通风柜不是仓库

shots.section_title: 台面和通风柜不是仓库
shots.scene: 通风柜里塞满瓶子，气流被挡
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood crammed with bottles; airflow arrows are blocked. No text.
shots.narration: 通风柜也不能堆试剂。

shots.section_title: 台面和通风柜不是仓库
shots.scene: 胳膊碰倒台面瓶子，旁边火焰无遮挡
shots.prompt_en: An elbow knocks over a bottle on the bench; a small flame nearby has no barrier. No text.
shots.narration: 容易碰倒，着火时也没有保护。

shots.section_title: 放低放稳，大瓶下层配托盘
shots.scene: 瓶子放在地上和柜顶，都打叉
shots.prompt_en: Bottles on the floor and on top of a tall cabinet, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 试剂不放地上、不放高处。
overlay: 放低放稳，大瓶下层配托盘

shots.section_title: 放低放稳，大瓶下层配托盘
shots.scene: 【实拍】把大瓶试剂放到柜子下层的托盘里（用装清水的空瓶示范，遮挡品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Hands place a large bottle into a tray on the lowest cabinet shelf. No readable text.
shots.narration: 大瓶酸碱放下层，配上托盘。

shots.section_title: 放低放稳，大瓶下层配托盘
shots.scene: 托盘接住漏出的液体
shots.prompt_en: A tray under a bottle catches a small leak. No text.
shots.narration: 漏了，托盘能接住。

shots.scene: 货架用支架固定在墙上
shots.prompt_en: A storage shelf anchored to the wall with brackets. No text.
shots.narration: 货架要牢固，固定在墙上。

shots.scene: 隔板边缘有挡边，瓶子靠里放
shots.prompt_en: A shelf with a raised lip; bottles are pushed back from the edge. No text.
shots.narration: 隔板有挡边，瓶子往里推。

shots.scene: 架子不超载，重物在下
shots.prompt_en: A shelf with light items on top and heavy items at the bottom, not overloaded. No text.
shots.narration: 不超载，重的放下面。

shots.scene: 柜里塞满囤积的试剂，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet overstuffed with hoarded reagent bottles, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 存量够用就好，不囤货。

shots.scene: 瓶子越多，火焰图标越大
shots.prompt_en: As more bottles pile up, a flame icon grows bigger. No text.
shots.narration: 存得越多，出事时后果越重。

shots.scene: 王老师指着一张存量规定
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank rule sheet on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 实验室能存多少，按学校规定。

shots.scene: 柜外的易燃液体超量，多出的放进安全柜
shots.prompt_en: Extra flammable liquid bottles outside move into a safety cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 柜外易燃液体有上限，多了进安全柜。

shots.scene: 领用登记，用多少领多少
shots.prompt_en: A student signs a sign-out book and takes a small amount. No readable text.
shots.narration: 用多少，领多少。

shots.scene: 试剂柜里有个瓶子没有标签，问号
shots.prompt_en: A bottle without a label in the cabinet, a question mark above it. No text.
shots.narration: 试剂柜里，哪里不对？

shots.scene: 每瓶都贴好标签，摆放整齐
shots.prompt_en: Every bottle now has a label and stands neatly in rows. No text.
shots.narration: 都要有标签，摆放整齐。

shots.scene: 台账和柜里的瓶子一一对应
shots.prompt_en: Lines connect ledger entries to bottles in the cabinet one by one. No text.
shots.narration: 台账和实物要对得上。

shots.scene: 电脑上记录入库、领用、剩余三栏
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen with three blank columns and arrows for in, out and remaining. No text.
shots.narration: 入库、领用、剩余，都要记录。

shots.scene: 老周拿手电检查柜里的瓶子
shots.prompt_en: The older man inspects bottles in a cabinet with a flashlight.
shots.narration: 经常检查储存的容器。

shots.scene: 瓶盖锈蚀、瓶底渗漏、液体变色三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a corroded cap, a leaking bottom, discolored liquid. No text.
shots.narration: 看有没有腐蚀、渗漏、变质。

shots.scene: 架边的瓶子被推进去
shots.prompt_en: A hand pushes a bottle back from the shelf edge. No text.
shots.narration: 靠在架边的瓶子，往里推。

shots.section_title: 过期变质试剂及时清理
shots.scene: 柜子深处一瓶落满灰的老试剂
shots.prompt_en: A dusty old bottle at the back of a cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 柜子深处的老试剂，也是隐患。
overlay: 过期变质试剂及时清理

shots.section_title: 过期变质试剂及时清理
shots.scene: 过期瓶子登记后放进回收箱
shots.prompt_en: Expired bottles are logged and placed into a collection box. No text.
shots.narration: 过期、变质、标签不清，登记处置。

shots.section_title: 过期变质试剂及时清理
shots.scene: 标签模糊的瓶子贴上待鉴定标记，老周登记
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a faded label gets a pending tag while the older man logs it.
shots.narration: 标签看不清的，按未知物上报。

shots.section_title: 过期变质试剂及时清理
shots.scene: 倒进水槽打叉
shots.prompt_en: Pouring an old reagent into a sink is crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 交学校统一处置，别自己倒掉。

shots.scene: 分区柜、隔板、托盘、台账四个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of zoned cabinets, a divider, a tray and a ledger, each with a green check. No text.
shots.narration: 分类分区，禁配隔开，放低放稳。

shots.scene: 少存、常查、及时清理三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a small stock, a magnifier, a recycling box, each with a check. No text.
shots.narration: 少存常查，过期及时清理。

shots.scene: 欣欣打开一个黄色易燃品柜，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a yellow flammable storage cabinet and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：安全柜与化学品冰箱。
